description: Always-on PulseEngine context: at session start inject the methodology memory, situational awareness (git state, repo category, resumed working context), and — in a rivet project — the traceability state plus the rivet command surface to use instead of grepping artifact YAML; write `setopt no_nomatch no_equals` (zsh only, once) into $CLAUDE_ENV_FILE so an unmatched glob or an `=word` stops failing the agent's Bash calls; persist a working-context checkpoint on session end and before compaction so work resumes instead of starting cold; at session start list the factory-notice answers waiting and, inside the owner's decision windows only, the decisions the attention budget surfaces, and at session end post an automatic summary when the agent wrote none and flush the notice outbox to warte; and before every Agent call that has no `model:` and would inherit the parent's model, add a non-blocking reminder to choose a tier per delegate-by-cost (never denies, approves or rewrites the call); and before every Bash call, deny a commit-making git command under a repo-local, -c or GIT_AUTHOR_* identity that differs from the global one unless the owner allow-listed it, and deny `gh pr merge --auto` on a GitHub repo whose default branch has no protection and no ruleset with required checks or a merge queue (an API failure fails open with a warning); deny `gh pr merge --admin` and API merges, a server-side rebase (`gh pr update-branch --rebase`), plain update-branch on a merge-queue repo, `--no-gpg-sign`, gpgsign off and identity writes outside temp dirs; ask before a direct merge whose head checks are not green, before a v-tag, release or publish that is not green origin main, and before a commit message, PR text or an Edit/Write into a git repo that carries a private hostname, LAN address or home path; add the fleet admission advice on `gh pr create`; and at session start warn in one line when signing is not configured.
